scenarios.name: encrypted_checkpoint_3node_throughput
scenarios.notes: 64 MiB checkpoint (64 x 1 MiB AES-256-GCM chunks) replicated 3/3 across independent HTTP nodes and verified end-to-end.

scenarios.name: agent_state_5kind_3node_replicated
scenarios.notes: All 5 #39 artifact kinds replicated 3/3; raw node scan found 0/3 canaries and 0/5 plaintext hashes leaked (0.0% leakage).

scenarios.name: sovereign_export_zero_hanzo_restore
scenarios.notes: Exported 5-kind agent state directly to file:// VFS keys (zero second disk format), killed all 3 original nodes, restored on fresh independent node (0 Hanzo calls), and verified child fork lineage.

scenarios.name: adversarial_trust_and_policy_matrix
scenarios.notes: Blocked 10/10 adversarial/policy attacks (unauthorized read, bit-flip, truncation, forged sig, untrusted owner, commercial/SPDX license violations, expired/mismatched/revoked consent).

scenarios.name: revocation_forward_security_epoch2
scenarios.notes: Revoked peer blocked 100% on Epoch 2 (both signed revocation list & omitted X25519 KeyEnvelope); authorized Peer B restored Epoch 2 cleanly.

scenarios.name: crypto_shred_erasure
scenarios.notes: Zeroed local DEK cache (1->0), replicated signed DeletionTombstone 3/3, deleted cooperative blobs, and blocked restore against retained uncooperative copy (ErrTombstoned).

scenarios.name: neg_1_unencrypted_content_addressed_negative
scenarios.notes: Honest Negative Regime #1: raw unencrypted content-addressed chunks leaked 3/3 sensitive memory canaries and 1/1 plaintext CIDs verbatim (100.0% leakage) — proving content addressing is NOT privacy.

scenarios.name: neg_2_revoked_peer_prior_epoch_boundary
scenarios.notes: Honest Negative Regime #2: 100% of post-revocation Epoch 2 artifacts blocked (ErrAccessDenied), while cached Epoch 1 data already received prior to revocation remains locally decryptable by Peer A (cryptographic boundary).

scenarios.name: neg_3_all_replicas_corrupted_eclipse_boundary
scenarios.notes: Honest Negative Regime #3: all 3 replicas poisoned; failed closed with 0 corrupted bytes accepted (6 corrupted chunks rejected, 100% safety) and 0.0% availability (liveness requires >= 1 honest replica).
